facts.claim: The Parliamentary Committee met in the House of Commons to inquire into the Hyderabad Deccan Mining Company.
facts.quote: The Parliamentary Committee appointed to inquire into the circumstances attending the formation and promotion of the H3'derabad Deccan Mining Company, Limited, the circumstances under which the concession was obtained, and the subsequent operations by parties interested on the London Stock Exchange, met in the House of Commons yesterday, Sir Henry James presiding.

facts.claim: The committee allowed the Nizam of Hyderabad and several company officials to appear by counsel.
facts.quote: The Committee allow the Nizam of Hyderabad, the Hyderabad Deccan Company, the Sirdar Diler Jung, Mr. Wilham Clarence Watson, Mr. Henry Parkinson Sharp, and Mr. James Graham Stewart to appear by counsel.

facts.claim: The company had issued £150,000 public shares and £850,000 concessionary shares.
facts.quote: He understood that it consisted of £150,000 pubhc shares and £850,000 concessionary shares.
